name: celesta-plugin-scripts
description: The shared plugin build script (scripts/plugins/build.mjs) and its helpers: a plugin's platform from rustc, its Cargo workspace from cargo metadata, its celesta-plugin.json, and its license files; the version bump script (bump-version.mjs) with its helper version.mjs; the list of the plugins a change affects (affected.mjs), from each plugin's inputs in the Cargo and pnpm dependency graphs and turbo.json (inputs.mjs, lockfile.mjs); and the skipped tests in a cargo test log (libtest.mjs), for scripts/report-skipped-tests.mjs.
